items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: Red Allen and Greely [Walton] and Barney Bigard and Albert Nicholas, all those guys were scattered, that's obvious. And they joined that band

ctx.x: You see. They wasn't interested that much, only for the playing, and I wasn't interested, only for the money. See, it wasn't no prestige for me. It should have been, though, because Joe Oliver was great, obviously, even when I heard him play, see. But I was kind of egotistical then because I worked with some great musicians up there, playing 'rangements, fantastic arrangements. If you remember - 'cause you don't remember, maybe - but Joe Oliver's band broke up in New York, at the Saratoga Club, because it wasn't…
Right, so what you're saying is that you've never made a, the King Oliver record dates did not make a strong impression on you because they were just -
